smoke.command: env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin TMPDIR=/tmp sh tests/run-tests.sh smoke

select.command: bash -o pipefail -c 'git diff --name-only -z origin/main... | env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin TMPDIR=/tmp sh tests/run-tests.sh select-paths | env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin TMPDIR=/tmp sh tests/run-tests.sh select'
